purpose: Normalize the evidence and vocabulary for every world-visible asset before a PublishedWorldAsset registry becomes runtime/editor authority.

existingAuthorityToKeep.rule: W42 must evolve/adapt the existing placeable registry; it must not create a parallel second placeable gameplay authority.

statusVocabulary.CERTIFIED: Production-approved source, identity, provenance, geometry, runtime/editor behavior, and visual acceptance.
statusVocabulary.CANDIDATE: Real source candidate exists but production certification is incomplete.
statusVocabulary.PROVISIONAL: Temporary mapping/structural lane that may remain usable during migration but is not final production authority.
statusVocabulary.PLACEHOLDER: Explicit development placeholder; forbidden in certified production scenes.
statusVocabulary.MISSING: Referenced identity or required artwork has no usable authoritative source.
statusVocabulary.LEGACY_ALIAS: Retained only to migrate old scenes/saves/IDs into the canonical asset identity.
statusVocabulary.REJECTED: Known semantically incorrect or unsuitable visual substitution.

well.reason: The previous well_pump source is Objects/Furniture/Water Cooler.png. It must remain quarantined until real well/fountain art is promoted.

greenhouse_marker.reason: The current construction_tape visual is development-only. Production greenhouse content should become a BuildingRecipe.

cave_entrance.reason: Cave entrances require structural connector/stamp authority rather than a single object-atlas slot.

rules: W41A is diagnostic and must not change terrain, renderer, editor, F3, scene persistence, or runtime asset selection.
Rendering successfully never implies production certification.
ObjectKind remains gameplay/save compatibility metadata; it must not be future visual identity authority.
Generated atlas coordinates are cache coordinates, not stable asset identity.
Authored scene asset IDs remain intact through W41 and migrate through aliases in W42/W43.
Intentional quarantines must be represented as policy, not repaired by exposing incorrect art.
Historical unregistered validators are reference only and must not override later quarantine decisions.
No new production world content may depend on scene_placeholder, needsAtlasArt, construction_tape-as-greenhouse, or a newly invented ObjectKind-to-atlas identity.
